source_files.evidence: GovAuthorizationPolicy.CanModifyContract = return true (governance authorized to ATTEMPT migrate/admin-change)
migrate calls the contract's own migrate entry point
Sudo calls the contract's own sudo entry point
InstantiateContract: admin optional; admin empty when msg.Admin==''
selectAuthorizationPolicy: authority -> gov policy, else default

c2_immutability_resolved.conclusion: A contract with admin="" and NO migrate/sudo entry is code- and state-immutable against all in-protocol actors including governance; migrate/sudo require the contract's own entry which this contract does not expose. Only a chain-level governance software upgrade (hard-fork) can alter it — out of scope per VF-XCH-017. Bank balance requires the contract's own Execute; this contract transfers only the fixed fee, never principal pre-maturity.
c2_immutability_resolved.design_constraint: The deployed contract MUST expose no migrate and no sudo entry (enforced structurally in cosmos-hub-vault/src/lib.rs).
